name: Xerox B230

variant.platform: same chassis as the Lexmark B2236dw (identical 355 x 333 mm footprint, 6.8 kg, ports, panel layout)

closed.includes: Xerox datasheet H x W x D = 232 x 355 x 333 mm. The 232 mm height includes the raised control-panel (LCD) wedge; the main top surface is at 216 mm (Xerox dimension graphic 216 x 356 x 333 mm, same as the Lexmark B2236dw's 215 mm). Depth is the closed body with the tray at Letter length and the paper stop folded; with A4 paper the tray pokes out of the back by about 1-2 cm behind a dust flap (ITPro).

weight_kg.what: printer as specified by Xerox (15 lb)

connectivity.details: Hi-Speed USB 2.0 Type B, Ethernet 10/100BaseTX, Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n; AirPrint, Mopria, Wi-Fi Direct; no front USB host port

paper.input_type: front cassette (A4 length makes it poke out of the back under a dust flap)
paper.output_type: top tray, face down, with fold-up paper stop
paper.manual_feed: single-sheet slot behind a flap in the front door

display: 2-line monochrome LCD with a 4-way pad, OK, Back, Home, Menu and Stop buttons

toner.starter_note: EU/international datasheet: 1,200-page starter; the US datasheet says about 700 pages

in_the_box.items: printer; pre-installed starter toner (1,200 pages) and imaging unit; power cord; Software and Documentation CD (drivers, user guide, safety/regulatory/recycling, warranty); installation guide with product safety sheet; quick use guide. No USB or network cable.
in_the_box.region: Europe/international datasheet (B230V_DNI, the variant sold in Israel); no Israeli listing with a box list found
in_the_box.notes: US B230/DNI box is the same but with a ~700-page starter toner (Staples, Xerox US datasheet)

ils.where: Rikotek via Zap (incl. 35 ILS shipping; cheapest of 22 shops, range 534-1,044)

usd.where: Adorama (also sold by Adorama on Best Buy marketplace); Xerox store/Staples $189.99

power.type: C13 plug into a C14 inlet (mounted turned 90 deg, long side vertical)
power.position: in its own notch at the bottom of the rear corner on the printer's left side (seen from the front): 2.4 cm from the right edge seen from behind (x = -15.3 cm in the model), 4.1 cm above the bottom
power.plug_inside_outline: mostly: the C13 housing (about 3.4 cm) sits inside the notch; only its strain relief (about 2.4 cm) and the bent cable stick out

data.type: Ethernet (RJ45); USB-B 4 cm below it in the same notch
data.position: in a notch higher up the same rear corner: 1.2 cm from the right edge seen from behind (x = -16.6 cm), RJ45 16.3 cm above the bottom, USB-B 12.3 cm
data.plug_inside_outline: mostly: the RJ45 plug ends about 0.6 cm inside the back; only its boot sticks out (about 1.9 cm behind the body with the cable bent)

cable_space.why: Both notches are cut into the rounded rear-left corner and open to the back and the side (real photo 12_back_ports_real). The plug bodies fit inside, so this is close to the user's 'recessed' case, but the kettle plug's strain relief still sticks out about 2.2 cm and the cable needs a bend: 3.3 cm in the 3D model (power), 1.9 cm for Ethernet. An angled (right-angle) C13 cord would bring it to about 1.5-2 cm.
cable_space.a4_tray_note: With A4 or Legal paper the 250-sheet tray extends out of the back at the bottom centre under a dust cover (about 2 cm for A4 by the paper lengths; ITPro review; real photo 11_back34_real). It is beside, not behind, the power notch and shorter than the power cable reach. Not modelled.
cable_space.source: photos 11_back34_real and 12_back_ports_real (OLX.pl used unit), 03_back (Xerox render), User Guide p.34

notes: Model done (see measurements/MEASUREMENTS.md, Model status). Height 232 mm is the overall height with the LCD pod; the top cover is at 216 mm (Xerox dimension graphic).
